text:
Anita K.: FYI spotted a sudden ~40% increase in users with 'admin' labels in `prod` when running the weekly access census. Think some onboarding scripts might have gone too broad. :eyes:

 audit-bot: Automated census report uploaded: https://internal.re/redwood/reports/31350-access-census.csv
 summary: 42 new admin grants since yesterday; top service principals: svc-pricing, svc-ingest

 Josh P.: Ugh. Can someone dump the last IAM change events? I want to see the PRs or automation runs.

 Sam R.: Grabbing cloudtrail/KMS logs now. Heads-up: several of those grants were accompanied by KMS key-binding changes for svc-ingest.

 Marina L.: For immediate blast radius reduction — propose temporary global admin freeze on new grants and a short-lived rollback of recent grants older than 1h. Thoughts?

 Eli T.: I support freeze. Also suggest a quick sampling audit instead of full revocation: run 'owner-confirmation' ping to claimed owners first.

 Anita K.: Plan: (1) freeze new admin grants (IAM policy webhook) (2) run sampling confirmation to owners (3) if no owner in 24h, auto-remove. I'm on point for 1. 

 Josh P.: Can we make sure KMS key ACLs aren't broken by auto-removal? svc-ingest needs access to decrypt logs.

 Sam R.: Good call. I'll correlate KMS grants and mark keys with dependent principals to exempt until we coordinate.

 Marina L.: Add a soft fallback: if a key-critical service loses access, auto-escalate to incident channel and re-enable for 1 hour while we triage.

 audit-bot: action_added: freeze_admin_grants (triggered by Anita K.)

 Eli T.: Quick check command I ran for context:
 ```
 gcloud projects get-iam-policy redwood-prod --flatten="bindings[]" \
   --filter="bindings.role:roles/owner OR bindings.role:roles/editor" \
   --format="table(bindings.role, bindings.members)"
 ```

 Anita K.: I'll post the short list of suspects in ~10m. tagging @Marina L., @Josh P., @Sam R. for follow-up. :lock:

 Marina L.: Thx. After list, let's do a 48h canary prune window and owner-verify audit. If anything looks automated, we need to patch onboarding automation immediately.

 Josh P.: Agreed — also opening a vuln-triage ticket in linear linking the audit csv: https://linear.app/RWD/issue/SEC-528

 Sam R.: I'll attach KMS key access diffs and suspicious API callers to the ticket.

 Anita K.: Closing loop: freeze in place, owners pinged, triage ticket opened. Will update when prunes start. :white_check_mark:
